goal: Write a state-of-the-art forward-pass Triton kernel for fused scaled-dot-product attention in fp16 that beats PyTorch SDPA on an A100.
summary: Definition of Done for a fused fp16 scaled-dot-product attention Triton kernel on A100, covering compilation, correctness (including non-power-of-2 and causal variants), speedup vs PyTorch SDPA, TFLOPS efficiency, and latency at small shape.

checks.title: Kernel compiles and runs at small shape
checks.criteria: kernel.py imports and forward() executes without error at shape 1x4x128x64 fp16.

checks.title: Correctness vs PyTorch SDPA (non-causal, power-of-2)
checks.criteria: Max absolute error vs PyTorch SDPA reference is below 2e-2 at 2x8x1024x64 fp16 non-causal.

checks.title: Correctness vs PyTorch SDPA (non-power-of-2 seq)
checks.criteria: Max absolute error vs PyTorch SDPA reference is below 2e-2 at 1x4x1000x64 fp16 non-causal (non-power-of-2 length).

checks.title: Correctness vs PyTorch SDPA (causal)
checks.criteria: Max absolute error vs PyTorch SDPA causal reference is below 2e-2 at 2x8x1024x64 fp16 causal.

checks.title: Speedup vs PyTorch SDPA at headline shape
checks.criteria: Kernel is at least 1.0x faster than PyTorch SDPA at 8x16x2048x64 fp16 non-causal.

checks.title: TFLOPS at headline shape
checks.criteria: Kernel achieves at least 120 TFLOPS at 8x16x2048x64 fp16 non-causal.

checks.title: Latency at small shape
checks.criteria: Kernel forward pass completes in under 0.5 ms at 1x8x512x64 fp16 non-causal.

environment.rationale: The harness imports kernel.py and runs it on a real NVIDIA A100 over SSH, comparing against a PyTorch SDPA reference; no browser or macOS is needed.

design_facts: kernel.py exposes `def forward(q, k, v, causal: bool = False) -> torch.Tensor`; q,k,v are [batch, heads, seq, dim] fp16 CUDA tensors (contiguous); softmax scale = dim**-0.5; causal masks keys j > i; returns [batch, heads, seq, dim] in the input dtype.
kernel.py may import torch and triton; it must NOT call torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention, torch.matmul / @ / torch.bmm, or torch.softmax for the core op.
FlashAttention-2 style online softmax with fp32 accumulators, tile sizes BLOCK_M=128, BLOCK_N=64, num_warps 4-8, num_stages 2-3, and skip fully-masked causal tiles.
A100 fp16 tensor core peak is 312 TFLOPS; headline shape batch 8, heads 16, seq 2048, dim 64; small latency shape 1x8x512x64.
